_what: Hand-written source for Ep1 Act Four v5's access tracks. build_access.py reads this with the stick timeline and the takes. Times are ACT seconds (0 = the act's first frame = episode 12:31:00). Edit here, then re-run the tool; never hand-edit the generated .srt/.vtt/.md.
_rules: Plain SDH (elevation-ideas DET-19): no styling, Mas in sentence case (the lowercase subtitle convention belongs to the parked styled track), speaker IDs only where the speaker is not visible or not clear, sound captions only for sounds the stick bed actually contains (bed.py sound spots and room beds).
Real (record) words are shown as the take says them, with the script's print ellipses kept where the record is trimmed. Spelling follows the verified source (facts.md, Act Four v5 lock checks).

Audio description: plain, present tense, only what is on screen, never a motive or an interpretation, never ahead of the picture by more than about a second. It reads the story's silent text (posts, rails, plates) because a blind viewer gets it nowhere else.

ad: November 17, noon, Las Vegas. A board video call: Join.
A blueprint: How to fire a CEO.
Step one: noon, video call. He clicks Join.
The call, silent on his side. Alyi speaks.
A dialog: OK, Cancel. An arrow tagged Alyi moves onto Cancel.
His tile drops out: You've been removed from the meeting.
Night. He carves a third mark in his desk.
The Orb's light counts the marks.
Tpool, his first company. Two staff revolts. Reported.
Marks two and three. The Orb: rewinding. The board's side.
Nobody looks up. Her pen ticks step one.
No one answers. She posts it.
November 18. Hearts pour in. His post: sorta like reading your own eulogy while you're still alive.
She looks at the blank step four.
She dials. Split screen: Mario, runs the rival lab, reported.
Lobby camera, November 19: Mas, in a guest badge.
Night. The spotlight swings to Ttemme, who ran a streaming site.
He reads a sealed folder, turned away.
11:53 PM. The wall turns Macrosoft blue. A door opens: Tasya, the landlord.
Tasya lifts a sign: Mas, Gerg, and an arrow pointing out.
She writes a question mark. Mada says nothing.
A card: What they didn't know.
Rima's post: NopeAI is nothing without its people.
A check slides out of a slot.
A door rises behind him. A key turns.
The board's call. Employee tiles pile in: 745 of 770.
The quiet vote's black tile goes. Mada doesn't move.
Alyi posts: I deeply regret my participation in the board's actions. I never intended to harm NopeAI.
The bullpen: packed boxes, coats on.
November 21, 10 PM. Terb, the new chair, with an extinguisher.
Mada's spinner stops. He nods. Terb stamps it.
Gerg posts: Returning to NopeAI and getting back to coding tonight.
Ttemme posts: I am deeply pleased by this result.
The hourglass shatters. The lobby sign: Days since someone tried to fire Mas: zero.
The dialog again. Cancel is greyed out and refuses the click.
November 22. A steel vault, stenciled Q-star, hums.
Reported: researchers wrote of a breakthrough called Q-star.
Alyi's nameplate comes off; his door stays shut.
A Macrosoft chair unfolds: observer, non-voting.
